text: On a long enough time line, the survival rate for everyone drops to zero.
author: The Narrator
visual_brief: An orthographic engineering drawing of orbital decay, showing nested elliptical flight paths slowly spiraling inward toward a dark planetary sphere. Fine dashed tangent lines and minute inward-pointing vector arrows chart the inevitable collapse of the orbit, rendered in clean, technical white linework with delicate dimension markers.
alt: Technical diagram showing orbital trajectories spiraling inward toward a planet.
